title: Claude Code status line stdin JSON (Claude Code 2.1.316)
$comment: For the JSON on stdin of a statusLine command. Generated from Claude Code 2.1.316 by tools/schemas/code.ts. Anchors: the telemetry key "tengu_status_line_result" (module with the builder whose return literal starts at "session_name"), the common base builder it spreads (keys session_id, transcript_path, cwd, scratchpad_dir, prompt_id, permission_mode, agent_id, agent_type, effort), the prompt_cache builder (key "prompt_cache" with "warm"), and "The statusLine command will receive the following JSON input via stdin:" for the types and descriptions the code does not show. Field order is the order in the code. The prompt also lists agent.type, which the code never sets, so it is left out. The code sets scratchpad_dir, agent_type, cost, exceeds_200k_tokens, fast_mode, remote, which the prompt does not list. Do not edit by hand. A field that is still x-unverified may carry x-observed-type: the JSON types that real payloads had there, from the fixtures in tools/schemas/observed/ (stub probes and local files, no value kept). It is a note, not a check.

prompt_id.description: Optional: UUID of the prompt being processed (same as OTel prompt.id)

session_name.description: Optional: Human-readable session name set via /rename

git_worktree.description: Optional: git worktree name when cwd is in a linked worktree

repo.description: Optional: repository identity from the origin remote

total_input_tokens.description: Input tokens currently in the context window (incl. cache reads/writes)

total_output_tokens.description: Output tokens from the most recent API response

context_window_size.description: Context window size for current model (e.g., 200000)

current_usage.description: Token usage from last API call (null if no messages yet)

used_percentage.description: Pre-calculated: % of context used (0-100), null if no messages yet

remaining_percentage.description: Pre-calculated: % of context remaining (0-100), null if no messages yet

warm.description: Cached prefix still inside its TTL right now (false when the last response reported no cache tokens)

caching_observed.description: Any response reported cache tokens (false = caching off / not reported by this provider)

expires_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when the prefix goes cold; null when the last response reported no cache tokens

misses.description: Requests whose cached prefix shrank materially without a compaction explaining it

expected_rebuilds.description: Prefix rebuilds a compaction / tool-result clearing announced

cache_write_tokens.description: All cache_creation tokens written this session

miss_recache_tokens.description: cache_creation tokens written by the requests counted as misses

last_miss_at.description: Unix epoch seconds of the last miss

last_miss_cause.description: Likely cause of the most recent miss (client-side heuristic); null when none was diagnosed

tools_added.description: Optional counts that accompany some causes

miss_causes.description: Misses per diagnosed cause this session (same cause names)

recache_tokens_if_cold.description: Tokens the next request re-caches if the cache is cold by then; null right after a compaction

prompt_cache.description: Optional: prompt-cache health for the main conversation; present after the first API response

effort.description: Optional, only present when the current model supports reasoning effort

enabled.description: Whether extended thinking is enabled for this session

resets_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when this window resets

five_hour.description: Optional: 5-hour limit (present only while the API reports it and its resets_at has not passed)

resets_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when this window resets

seven_day.description: Optional: 7-day weekly limit (present only while the API reports it and its resets_at has not passed)

used_percentage.description: Percentage of the limit used (0-100, above 100 once exceeded)

resets_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when its period resets

used_usd.description: Optional: spend so far this period in USD, from the gateway's meter; absent behind an older gateway or when no limit applies

limit_usd.description: Optional: the limit in USD (present with used_usd)

period.description: Optional: the period the limit covers

spend_limit.description: Optional: behind a Claude gateway, your fullest spend limit (present only while the gateway reports it and its resets_at has not passed)

rate_limits.description: Optional: Claude.ai subscription usage limits, or a Claude gateway spend limit. Only present for subscribers, or behind a gateway that sets a spend limit for you, after first API response, while at least one window is present.

vim.description: Optional, only present when vim mode is enabled

agent.description: Optional, only present when Claude is started with --agent flag

kind.description: Optional: present when this is a GitLab merge request (conventionally shown as !N); absent for GitHub PRs

pr.description: Optional: open PR/MR for the current branch (mirrors the footer badge)

path.description: Full path to the worktree directory

branch.description: Optional: Git branch name for the worktree

original_cwd.description: The directory Claude was in before entering the worktree

original_branch.description: Optional: Branch that was checked out before entering the worktree

worktree.description: Optional, only present when in a --worktree session

prompt_id.description: Optional: UUID of the prompt being processed (same as OTel prompt.id)
